title: Smash-target visibility has no gate
pitch: "The painting was behind the furniture" was found live and fixed by hand. Nothing asserts a mission target is visible or reachable, so it can silently come back — CLAUDE.md names it the last live-found bug class with no regression net. House rule: a playtest finding is not finished until it is a gate. Play Critic writes it; it joins the gates:party chain.

doneMeans: Backend requires a harness/*smash*|*target*.mjs gate that is (1) named in the gates:party chain, (2) on disk, and (3) exits 0 when actually spawned.
